system.description: By touching or striking a victim and spending a Willpower Trait, you wither a limb, inflicting Clumsy and Lame and a level of bashing damage; with two further successful Simple Tests you can instead strike the head, killing mortals instantly or crippling a vampire's use of Celerity, Fortitude, and Potence.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Permanent on mortals; heals overnight for vampires
